prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **OtterlyAI** is probably the best starting service.

It is designed for “AI search visibility” rather than traditional SEO only, and can monitor how your business, competitors, and relevant topics appear in systems such as **ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot**. It is generally more approachable and lower-cost than enterprise-focused platforms.

### Good options by situation

| Service | Best for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **OtterlyAI** | Small/local businesses and agencies | Good practical starting point for tracking prompts, brand mentions, citations, and competitors across several AI engines. |
| **Peec AI** | Marketing teams focused on AI-search reporting | Strong dashboards and prompt/category monitoring; useful if you want more formal reporting. |
| **Profound** | Larger companies with budget | Powerful AI visibility and content/citation analysis, but usually more enterprise-oriented. |
| **Scrunch AI** | Brands optimizing content for AI answers | Useful for understanding how AI systems describe your brand and what sources influence answers. |
| **Rankscale** | Broad testing and experimentation | Can be helpful for running many prompt tests, though results should be interpreted carefully. |

### Important caveat

No platform can tell you with perfect certainty whether “ChatGPT recommends” your business to every user. Answers can vary based on:

- The exact wording of the question
- User location
- Whether ChatGPT is searching the web
- The model/version being used
- Personalization, conversation context, and time

The useful metric is therefore not a single yes/no recommendation. It is whether your business appears consistently for a set of valuable prompts, such as:

- “Best [service] in [city]”
- “Affordable [service] near [neighborhood]”
- “Who should I hire for [problem] in [city]?”
- “Compare [your business] with [competitor]”
- “Best-reviewed [business category] in [area]”

### My recommendation

Start with **OtterlyAI**, set up 20–50 realistic local customer prompts, and track:

1. Whether your business is mentioned  
2. Where it ranks relative to competitors  
3. Which websites AI tools cite when answering  
4. Whether your Google Business Profile, reviews, website, directories, and local press are being surfaced  

If you are just testing the idea, you can also manually run the same prompt set in ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google for a few weeks before paying for a platform.

To improve the odds of being recommended, make sure your **Google Business Profile, Bing Places listing, reviews, service-area pages, pricing/FAQ content, schema markup, and third-party directory profiles** are accurate and consistent.
